loyalty.title: Every 10th haircut is on us
loyalty.text: Ask for your loyalty card at the shop. Come 9 times, the 10th haircut is free.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Cash and bank card, on site. No online payment is required to book.
Yes! We have a dedicated kids haircut service (25 min), and Yassine is our specialist for little ones.

items.q: Can I walk in without an appointment?
items.a: Of course. Check the live waiting status on this page — if the queue is short, just come by. Booking online still guarantees your slot.
Yes, free cancellation up to 3 hours before your appointment, from the confirmation screen or the link in your reminder.
Yes, with your booking reference you can move your appointment to any free slot, up to 3 hours before the original time.

items.q: How does the loyalty card work?
items.a: Each haircut earns a stamp. On your 10th visit, that haircut is free. Cards are available at the shop.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.p1: We collect only what a booking needs: your name, your phone number and, if you choose, your email and a short note. We use them solely to manage your appointment and, if you wish, to send you a reminder.
privacy.p2: Data is stored securely, is never sold or shared with third parties, and is deleted on request. We comply with Tunisian organic law 2004-63 on personal data protection (INPDP) and apply GDPR principles for visitors from the EU.
privacy.p3: You may access, correct or delete your data at any time via WhatsApp or by phone. Deleting your booking deletes your data.
